response.sql: WITH per_race AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings WHERE points > 6.0 GROUP BY raceId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg FROM per_race) SELECT p.raceId, p.avg_points, p.avg_wins, p.avg_wins - o.overall_avg AS diff FROM per_race p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff DESC, p.raceId ASC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Races with no standings entries having points > 6.0 do not appear (grouping happens after filtering), so the overall average is taken only over races that have at least one qualifying entry.
Ties in the difference are broken by raceId ascending; NULL differences sort last (a NULL avg_wins is possible only if all wins are NULL, and SQLite's DESC puts NULLs last).
